name: recovering media production held for a person
from: Flow production is held (hold.json, exit 75, PUBLIC_ERROR_UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY, signed out) or Notebook cannot read its usage.
to: The person at the worker's machine has been walked through what Google asked by one command (recover-google-flow), the session is verified with ONE generation the person consented to, and the queue has resumed; or the hold stands with its reason and command visible to the host.
cost: A few minutes of the person's attention, once; one verification clip (about 10 credits) with the person's consent.
otherwise: Production waits on a step nobody was told about; the Leader's 2026-10-12 report that he did not know how to do it stays true.
receiver-condition: The thread's assayer, or an office of its opener, reads the evidence (the allowance plan and idle record, the hold and recovery result, or the migration report and operating-observation record) and accepts or declines it; the lead never receives its own work.
